units.leftText: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
units.rightText: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
leftNotes: 1:1 BYZ and TR include from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
units.rightText: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

units.leftText: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

units.leftText: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
units.rightText: knowing, brethren beloved of God, your election,

units.leftText: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction — just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
units.rightText: how that our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and in much assurance; even as ye know what manner of men we showed ourselves toward you for your sake.

units.leftText: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
units.rightText: And ye became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit;

units.leftText: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
units.rightText: so that ye became an ensample to all that believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

units.leftText: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
units.rightText: For from you hath sounded forth the word of the Lord, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith to God-ward is gone forth; so that we need not to speak anything.

units.leftText: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
units.rightText: For they themselves report concerning us what manner of entering in we had unto you; and how ye turned unto God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

units.leftText: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead — Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
units.rightText: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.

units.leftText: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
units.rightText: For yourselves, brethren, know our entering in unto you, that it hath not been found vain:

units.leftText: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
units.rightText: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as ye know, at Philippi, we waxed bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God in much conflict.

units.leftText: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
units.rightText: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

units.leftText: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
units.rightText: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.

units.leftText: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
units.rightText: For neither at any time were we found using words of flattery, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness, God is witness;

units.leftText: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
units.rightText: nor seeking glory of men, neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
leftNotes: 2:6 Or although as apostles of Christ we could have been a burden to you; SBL, NE, and WH include this phrase with verse 7.

units.leftText: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
units.rightText: But we were gentle in the midst of you, as when a nurse cherisheth her own children:
leftNotes: 2:7 WH and NA we were like young children among you

units.leftText: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
units.rightText: even so, being affectionately desirous of you, we were well pleased to impart unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were become very dear to us.

units.leftText: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
units.rightText: For ye remember, brethren, our labor and travail: working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

units.leftText: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
units.rightText: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and righteously and unblamably we behaved ourselves toward you that believe:

units.leftText: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
units.rightText: as ye know how we dealt with each one of you, as a father with his own children, exhorting you, and encouraging you, and testifying,

units.leftText: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
units.rightText: to the end that ye should walk worthily of God, who calleth you into his own kingdom and glory.

units.leftText: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
units.rightText: And for this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when ye received from us the word of the message, even the word of God, ye accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also worketh in you that believe.

units.leftText: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
units.rightText: For ye, brethren, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judæa in Christ Jesus: for ye also suffered the same things of your own countrymen, even as they did of the Jews;

units.leftText: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
units.rightText: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove out us, and please not God, and are contrary to all men;

units.leftText: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them. Paul’s Longing to Visit
units.rightText: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always: but the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
leftNotes: 2:16 Or at last the wrath (of God) has come upon them.

units.leftText: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
units.rightText: But we, brethren, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence not in heart, endeavored the more exceedingly to see your face with great desire:

units.leftText: For we wanted to come to you — indeed I, Paul, tried again and again — but Satan obstructed us.
units.rightText: because we would fain have come unto you, I Paul once and again; and Satan hindered us.

units.leftText: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
units.rightText: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of glorying? Are not even ye, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

units.leftText: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
units.rightText: For ye are our glory and our joy.

units.leftText: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
units.rightText: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone;

units.leftText: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
units.rightText: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s minister in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith;
leftNotes: 3:2 Or our brother and God’s fellow worker; NE, WH, BYZ, and TR our brother and minister of God

units.leftText: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
units.rightText: that no man be moved by these afflictions; for yourselves know that hereunto we are appointed.

units.leftText: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
units.rightText: For verily, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

units.leftText: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain. Timothy’s Encouraging Report
units.rightText: For this cause I also, when I could no longer forbear, sent that I might know your faith, lest by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor should be in vain.

units.leftText: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
units.rightText: But when Timothy came even now unto us from you, and brought us glad tidings of your faith and love, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, longing to see us, even as we also to see you;

units.leftText: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
units.rightText: for this cause, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith:

units.leftText: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
units.rightText: for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

units.leftText: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
units.rightText: For what thanksgiving can we render again unto God for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

units.leftText: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith.
units.rightText: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

units.leftText: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
units.rightText: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way unto you:

units.leftText: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
units.rightText: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you;

units.leftText: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
units.rightText: to the end he may establish your hearts unblamable in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

units.leftText: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
units.rightText: Finally then, brethren, we beseech and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that, as ye received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, even as ye do walk,—that ye abound more and more.

units.leftText: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
units.rightText: For ye know what charge we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

units.leftText: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
units.rightText: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye abstain from fornication;

units.leftText: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
units.rightText: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
leftNotes: 4:4 Literally know how to possess his own vessel

units.leftText: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
units.rightText: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who know not God;

units.leftText: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
units.rightText: that no man transgress, and wrong his brother in the matter: because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
leftNotes: 4:6 Or no one should ever harm or cheat his brother in this matter

units.leftText: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
units.rightText: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

units.leftText: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
units.rightText: Therefore he that rejecteth, rejecteth not man, but God, who giveth his Holy Spirit unto you.

units.leftText: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
units.rightText: But concerning love of the brethren ye have no need that one write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another;

units.leftText: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
units.rightText: for indeed ye do it toward all the brethren that are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brethren, that ye abound more and more;

units.leftText: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
units.rightText: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your hands, even as we charged you;

units.leftText: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone. The Return of the Lord
units.rightText: that ye may walk becomingly toward them that are without, and may have need of nothing.

units.leftText: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
units.rightText: But we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning them that fall asleep; that ye sorrow not, even as the rest, who have no hope.
leftNotes: 4:13 Literally those who have fallen asleep, as in verses 14 and 15

units.leftText: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
units.rightText: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also that are fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

units.leftText: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
units.rightText: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we that are alive, that are left unto the coming of the Lord, shall in no wise precede them that are fallen asleep.

units.leftText: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
units.rightText: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first;

units.leftText: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
units.rightText: then we that are alive, that are left, shall together with them be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

units.leftText: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
units.rightText: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

units.leftText: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
units.rightText: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

units.leftText: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
units.rightText: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

units.leftText: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
units.rightText: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

units.leftText: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
units.rightText: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

units.leftText: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
units.rightText: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

units.leftText: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
units.rightText: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

units.leftText: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
units.rightText: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

units.leftText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
units.rightText: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

units.leftText: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: For God appointed us not unto wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

units.leftText: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
units.rightText: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

units.leftText: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing. Christian Living
units.rightText: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

units.leftText: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
units.rightText: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

units.leftText: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
units.rightText: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

units.leftText: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
units.rightText: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

units.leftText: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
units.rightText: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

units.leftText: Rejoice at all times.
units.rightText: Rejoice always;

units.leftText: Pray without ceasing.
units.rightText: pray without ceasing;

units.leftText: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

units.leftText: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
units.rightText: Quench not the Spirit;

units.leftText: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
units.rightText: despise not prophesyings;

units.leftText: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
units.rightText: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

units.leftText: Abstain from every form of evil. Final Blessings and Instructions
units.rightText: abstain from every form of evil.

units.leftText: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
leftNotes: 5:23 Or may your spirit, soul, and body be kept entirely blameless

units.leftText: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
units.rightText: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

units.leftText: Brothers, pray for us as well.
units.rightText: Brethren, pray for us.

units.leftText: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
units.rightText: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

units.leftText: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
units.rightText: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

units.leftText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
units.rightText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
